name: 97801 · Pendleton, OR
findings: ZIP 97801 (Pendleton) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97801 (Pendleton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
49% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
